description: Link a CallPilotAI record (contact, lead, account, campaign) to a record in a connected system — e.g. a TenderAIze tender or dossier. The link is visible from both sides and can be removed again without touching either record. CallPilotAI stays the leading system: this creates a reference, not a copy.

external_kind.description: What it is over there: pachtvertrag, flaeche, vorgang, vergabe, dossier … Free text, because every specialist system has its own words.

external_label.description: What it is called over there — so a human recognises it without opening the other system.

external_url.description: Deep link into the leading system. This is what makes a reference useful: the CRM shows the pointer, the specialist system keeps the logic. No deadline is computed and no rule is run on a reference — that is the whole point of one.

name: link_external_record
